guidelines.detail: same as LRN-001 (The description requires both activities without prescribing their order, and the missing-flow records support the absent parallel split and its branches. This guideline is already captured by learned guideline LRN-001.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The generated labels combine actions that the reference represents as separate tasks, while the description supports those distinct actions. FID-02 already advises against merging separately described actions into one task.)

same as LRN-008 (The description identifies an action before the process work, and the reference models it as a task while the generated model represents it with start events. This matches learned guideline LRN-008 and refines the broad documented instruction to model every distinct activity.)

refines FID-02 (The description groups each pair of actions as one activity, while the label pairs show the corresponding generated task being matched to separate reference tasks. This refines FID-02 by clarifying how to handle coordinated actions stated as one activity.)

same as LRN-036 (The description requires both activities and allows either order (S3–S4); the missing flows are consistent with the reference modeling them as parallel branches (F8–F9, F12). This supports the parallel-branch guideline without relying on the reference’s disputed placement of the functionality test (F14).)

same as LRN-096 (The generated combined task labels match the description’s coordinated activities, while the reference splits those activities into separate tasks. This is the situation addressed by LRN-096; FID-02 does not contradict it because the description presents each pair of actions as one activity.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents multiple required activities within the same stage without specifying an order or a decision between them: model the activities as parallel branches from a parallel gateway
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that two or more required activities must all occur, but may occur in any order

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple distinct actions within one activity, and those actions are described as separate work steps

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the described action as an activity after that event; do not use the start event alone to represent the action.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant performs an action that initiates the process before the main process work begins

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents multiple coordinated actions as one activity: Model the stated activity as one BPMN task and label it to preserve all of its coordinated actions; do not split the actions into separate tasks unless the description gives a process reason to do so.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents multiple coordinated actions as one activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one activity continues while another activity occurs before a later step: Model the concurrent activities as parallel branches, then synchronize them before a later step that depends on both being complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that several activities are all required but does not prescribe their order.
